title: Bayes' Theorem
subtitle: Probability · Conditional probability
summary: Updates the probability of a hypothesis given new evidence.
detail:
\[ P(A\mid B) = \frac{P(B\mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)} \]

The prior \(P(A)\) is updated by the likelihood \(P(B\mid A)\) to produce the posterior \(P(A\mid B)\). Foundation of Bayesian statistics, machine learning, and Bayesian networks. The denominator \(P(B)=\sum_i P(B\mid A_i)P(A_i)\) is a normalisation constant.
